Name: Miku Mod Dialogue
Author: SASCHA889
Description:
[size=4][b]Description [/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Hi! I SASCHA889. And I am a self-taught Russian mod maker.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]I was planning on creating a mod with over 100 dialogues, but I was unfamiliar with the author's code, so I had to spend some time studying it. In the end, I made about 11 dialogues. Even though there aren't many of them yet (for now), they work and don't block the author's original dialogues. This means both the author's dialogues and mine will play.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]All rights to the original mod belong to Tikamin557.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]The mod also has translations: Russian, English, Japanese.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]In the future I will add: More dialogues and events that do not have functions in the original, and more.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]If you have any problems, you can write to me. I might not respond right away, but I will.Well, this also concerns questions, also for me:).[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Special thanks to Tikamin557 for allowing modifications and creation of mods including his.[/b][/size]

Downloads.Description: This mod is still in development, so there may be some bugs. But I'm not sure :)
